sentences.text: Here’s The Emperor’s New Clothes by Hans Christian Andersen.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Here’s The Emperor’s New Clothes by Hans Christian Andersen.]

sentences.text: Once upon a time, an emperor liked clothes very much.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Once upon a time, an emperor liked clothes very much.]

sentences.text: He wanted to buy some new clothes.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: He wanted to buy some new clothes.]

sentences.text: Two brothers came and lied to him,
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Two brothers came and lied to him,]

sentences.text: “We can make wonderful clothes!
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: “We can make wonderful clothes!]

sentences.text: But only clever people can see them!”
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: But only clever people can see them!”]

sentences.text: They pretended to make the clothes.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: They pretended to make the clothes.]

sentences.text: The emperor’s officials couldn’t see the clothes,
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: The emperor’s officials couldn’t see the clothes,]

sentences.text: but they said, “What lovely clothes!”
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: but they said, “What lovely clothes!”]

sentences.text: The emperor couldn’t see anything either,
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: The emperor couldn’t see anything either,]

sentences.text: but he said, “They’re beautiful!”
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: but he said, “They’re beautiful!”]

sentences.text: No one wanted to look silly.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: No one wanted to look silly.]

sentences.text: The emperor decided to show everyone his new clothes.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: The emperor decided to show everyone his new clothes.]

sentences.text: People in the street praised them.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: People in the street praised them.]

sentences.text: They were afraid to look silly too!
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: They were afraid to look silly too!]

sentences.text: Suddenly, a boy shouted,
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Suddenly, a boy shouted,]

sentences.text: “Look! The emperor has no clothes on!”
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: “Look! The emperor has no clothes on!”]

sentences.text: Everyone looked at one another.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: Everyone looked at one another.]

sentences.text: They started laughing.
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: They started laughing.]

sentences.text: The end! Did you like the story?
sentences.translation: [需要翻译: The end! Did you like the story?]

sentences.text: Please tell me what you think!
